channel.description: The Straits Times - Get exclusive stories, in-depth analyses and award-winning multimedia content about Singapore, Asia and the world.

item.title: Nations row over fossil fuels as COP31 goes into overtime
item.description: Nearly 200 nations are deadlocked after two weeks of grinding negotiations in Turkey.

item.title: Many Etsy sellers close up shop over site’s new AI policy
item.description: Etsy said it would revise its policy after hearing complaints from sellers.

item.title: Magnitude 6.8 quake in Peru's Andean region sends Lima residents onto streets
item.description: LIMA, Nov 20 - A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck central Peru on Friday, the German Research Centre for Geosciences said, sending some in the capital Lima into the streets, though there were no immediate reports of casualties or significant damage.

item.title: Mexican cell carriers facing widespread outages, users report
item.description: MEXICO CITY, Nov 20 - Mexican cellphone users reported widespread service outages on Friday affecting Telcel, AT&T Mexico and Movistar, marking the latest disruption to mobile networks in the country.

item.title: Texas inmate complained of pain during execution: Witnesses
item.description: Dennes was killed by the drug, pentobarbital, used in a prior failed execution in September.

item.title: 6.7-magnitude earthquake shakes Peru’s Andes, with no damage or casualties immediately reported
item.description: The quake’s epicenter was in the Andes, 34km north of Junin, at a depth of 108km.

item.title: Fresh off China trip, Trump bobs and weaves in freewheeling press conference
item.description: The wide-ranging press conference lasted 1-1/2 hours at the White House.

item.title: Suspect in Los Angeles’ deadly Palisades fire convicted of arson at retrial
item.description: Jonathan Rinderknecht faces up to 20 years in prison for each offence.

item.title: Mamdani sets plan to close NYC’s notorious Rikers Island jail
item.description: Rikers will close and be replaced with four smaller, more modern jails by 2027.

item.title: ‘He’s a killer’: Zelensky on Putin after Trump calls Russian leader a ‘friend’
item.description: “For us he’s an enemy, and of course, for us, he is a killer,” Zelensky told CNN.

item.title: Threats, insults, settlements: How Nvidia’s ex-CEO Jensen Huang made humiliation routine
item.description: The behaviour kept Nvidia’s human resources department busy fielding workplace complaints.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepts three Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh
item.description: Nov 21 - The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Saturday it had intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired towards Riyadh, marking the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in a few days, after its tallest skyscraper was struck on Thursday.

item.title: Waymo recalls self-driving cars over closed freeway lanes, manual traffic control
item.description: This comes after a California regulator barred Waymo vehicles from freeways in the state.

item.title: Honda, Toyota to recall 1.6 million vehicles over Takata airbag rupture risk
item.description: There have been at least 28 deaths in the US stemming from defective Takata airbag inflators since 2009.

item.title: Araqchi says Iran wants diplomacy to end war, Trump says terms unacceptable
item.description: Nov 20 - Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Tehran still hoped diplomacy could end its war with the United States, while US President Donald Trump said Iran wanted a deal but one that was not acceptable to him.

item.title: While You Were Sleeping: 5 stories you might have missed, Nov 21, 2026
item.description: While You Were Sleeping: 5 stories you might have missed, Nov 21, 2026.

item.title: New caravan of about 300 migrants crosses into southern Mexico
item.description: MEXICO CITY/CHIAPAS, Mexico, Nov 20 - A caravan of about 300 migrants, mostly from Central America, crossed into southern Mexico on Friday to join a larger group heading north, a week after US President Donald Trump threatened fresh tariffs on Mexico if it did not halt the movement.

item.title: Austrian foreign ministry says its website was hacked, staff details viewed
item.description: VIENNA, Nov 20 - Austria's foreign ministry said on Friday its website was hacked last week and records containing the contact details of its staff were viewed, though it did not say whom it suspected of penetrating its cyber defences.

item.title: US V-P Vance declines to say he would have ordered Iran strikes
item.description: Vance has long opposed the war and acted as Washington’s main emissary for peace talks.

item.title: Aim is to ‘polarise’: Influencer deepfakes used to stoke Canada-US tensions
item.description: Content creators say their identities are being stolen to create division.

item.title: Brazil ex-President Bolsonaro hospitalized with intestinal obstruction
item.description: BRASILIA, Nov 20 - Imprisoned former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasilia on Friday with an intestinal obstruction after suffering abdominal pain and distension, said his doctor and a statement from the hospital.

item.title: French Senate approves police shootings law dubbed 'licence to kill' by critics
item.description: PARIS, Nov 20 - French senators gave final approval on Friday to a law presuming that police officers who use their weapons are acting lawfully, a proposal that left-wing parliamentarians oppose and seek to challenge at the Constitutional Council.

item.title: Anthropic researcher says AI chatbot Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle
item.description: The claim regarding the Riemann Hypothesis has not been independently verified.

item.title: Two veto-wielding powers reject Costa Rica’s Grynspan as UN chief in poll, sources say
item.description: GENEVA, Nov 20 - Two permanent members of the UN Security Council voted against Costa Rica's Rebeca Grynspan in an informal poll on Friday, three diplomatic sources told Reuters.

item.title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over attempt to kill Ukrainian rapper
item.description: Denmark may suspend Schengen visas for the European border-free area to Russian nationals.

item.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang agreed to testify at public US Senate hearing, senator's aide says
item.description: WASHINGTON, Nov 20 - Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before the US Senate in a public hearing, an aide to Republican US Senator Tim Scott said in a statement on Friday, as lawmakers probe allegations about Huang's ties to a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

item.title: Three Salvadorans killed in Haiti handling explosives in first official deaths since deployment
item.description: SAN SALVADOR, Nov 20 - Three Salvadoran soldiers were killed while working with explosives in Haiti, El Salvador's military said on Friday, marking the first officially reported deaths under the large-scale deployment that began a month ago.

item.title: Thorny UN talks on regulating 'killer robots' drag past deadline
item.description: GENEVA, Nov 20 - UN talks on rules for autonomous weapons headed into overtime on Friday with some nations including Russia dragging their feet and negotiators considering a non-binding deal on arms with minimal human oversight that may become common on battlefields.

item.title: Trump defends calling Russia’s Putin a friend, but says he ‘can’t speak’ to whether he’s a friend to the US
item.description: Trump raised eyebrows in China with his warm welcome for the Russian leader.

item.title: European emissions proposal faces Middle East pushback at UN aviation agency
item.description: MONTREAL, Nov 20 - Plans to change the European Union's Emissions Trading System faced pushback at a global aviation gathering that wraps up on Friday, as Middle East countries challenged fresh efforts to curb pollution from airlines outside an existing deal.

item.title: Trump says he, Russia’s Putin had ‘very good’ talks on Ukraine
item.description: Trump wants a deal before he discusses security guarantees for Ukraine.

item.title: Mayor Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
item.description: Nov 20 - New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Friday unveiled his plan to close the city's infamous Rikers Island jail complex by 2032, five years after a previously set deadline, and replace it with four borough-based jails, expanded mental healthcare, re-entry programs, and other measures.

item.title: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani injured in soccer match against journalists
item.description: Zohran Mamdani revealed in a press briefing that he had torn his Achilles tendon.

item.title: Trump says he plans to penalise US tech companies that build AI data centres in other countries
item.description: US tech companies will face “a tremendous tax”, said Trump, if thed build them overseas.

item.title: Houthi attacks add to worries over Trump Saudi nuclear power pact
item.description: Nov 20 - Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure are adding to concerns about US President Donald Trump's proposed nuclear power pact with the kingdom, weeks before US senators are due to vote on whether to block the agreement.

item.title: Spanish PM Sanchez's conservative rival wins TV face-off, polls show
item.description: MADRID, Nov 20 - Alberto Nunez Feijoo, the conservative frontrunner to oust Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez in next week's election, emerged as the perceived winner of their two-way TV debate, polling showed on Friday.

item.title: Indian man sentenced to more than 19 years in US for plotting to kill Sikh separatist
item.description: Alleged assassination plots against Sikh separatists in the US and Canada have tested relations with India.

item.title: Tanker catches fire after projectile strike near Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
item.description: CAIRO, Nov 20 - A tanker caught fire after being struck by an unknown projectile while sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said on Friday.

item.title: UK and EU strike deals on trade and travel, pledging to rebuild ties after Brexit
item.description: It comes a decade after Britain voted to leave the EU and six years after the divorce became final.

item.title: Trump, Xi agreed that military AI decisions should involve humans, Bessent says
item.description: The US Treasury Secretary was speaking to CNBC after returning from a meeting between Trump and Xi in China.

item.title: Saudi-led forces strike Yemen port as Houthis warn airlines off the kingdom
item.description: Nov 20 - The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said it had struck the Red Sea port of Hodeidah to destroy Houthi capabilities on Friday, as the militants warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, pledging new air strikes within hours.

item.title: Student protests held across Europe with demands from school funding to climate
item.description: COLOGNE, Germany/ROME, Nov 20 - A fresh wave of student protests took place across Europe on Friday, inspired by demonstrations that rocked France but far more muted, with demands ranging from more funding for education to climate justice and even ending conscription.

item.title: Nigeria rescue teams search for survivors after funeral barge capsizes in Bayelsa
item.description: YENAGOA, Nigeria, Nov 20 - Rescue workers are searching for survivors after a crowded barge carrying people to a funeral capsized in Nigeria's southern Bayelsa state, with several passengers feared dead, police and local residents said on Friday.

item.title: Founder of UK anti-migrant group jailed for slashing small boat in Channel
item.description: Daniel Thomas - widely known as Danny Tommo - has built a large following online.

item.title: Myanmar genocide judgment may bolster Gaza case against Israel
item.description: THE HAGUE, Nov 20 - The International Court of Justice's landmark ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya will strengthen South Africa's genocide case against Israel over the war in Gaza, legal experts said, establishing a precedent that genocidal intent can coexist with a military objective.

item.title: European troops from 11 countries hold a drill in Poland for a potential post-war Ukraine mission
item.description: Around 2,800 personnel are taking part in the exercise.

item.title: UK man convicted of planning petrol bomb attack on migrant hotel
item.description: LONDON, Nov 20 - A British man prosecutors said was motivated by extreme right-wing ideology was convicted on Friday of planning a terrorist attack with petrol bombs on a hotel housing asylum seekers.

item.title: France probes actor Gerard Depardieu, author Michel Houellebecq over alleged gang rape
item.description: Depardieu is to learn next week if he will stand trial for raping another actress.

item.title: German minister sorry for calling Pentagon official’s view over Ukraine strikes ‘stupid’
item.description: Boris Pistorius said he regretted his inappropriate words, but would not withdraw his criticism.

item.title: In Yemen’s Aden, divided government forces prepare for a Houthi assault
item.description: ADEN, Nov 20 - As Yemen's Houthis push closer towards the temporary capital Aden against fragmented government forces, the city's inhabitants face a bleak choice: stay under fire or leave for an impoverished countryside.
